```{python}
#| include: false

#import packages and data
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.dates as mdates
import matplotlib.transforms as transforms
import seaborn as sns
from IPython.display import display, HTML

plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'sans-serif'
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Segoe UI', 'Arial', 'sans-serif']

df = pd.read_csv("environmental_report_sample_data.csv", parse_dates=["date"])
df_compare = pd.read_csv("bay_comparison.csv")

report_date = pd.to_datetime('2025-03-01')
report_date_str = report_date.strftime('%B %d, %Y')

metric_at_report_date = df[df['date'] == report_date]['metric_value'].mean()
goal = df['goal'].iloc[0]
progress_pct = (metric_at_report_date / goal) * 100

#set a dynamic status message based on week of month

```

## Progress as of `{python} report_date_str` {.centered-subtitle}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-align: center

fig, ax_main = plt.subplots()

#actuals line
sns.lineplot(data=df[df['date'] <= (report_date)],
                x = 'date',
                y = 'metric_value',
                marker = 'o',
                color = '#16a34a',
                label = 'Measured',
                zorder = 5,
                ax = ax_main)

#Projection line
sns.lineplot(data = df[df['date'] >= (report_date)],
                x = 'date',
                y = 'projection',
                linestyle = '--',
                color = '#16a34a',
                label = 'Projected',
                zorder = 5,
                ax = ax_main)

ax_main.axhline(y = (df['goal'].iloc[0]), color = '#14532d', linewidth = 2, zorder = 1)

#Full-axis vertical line indicating the day
ax_main.axvline(x = (report_date), color = '#6c2b81', linewidth = 2, zorder = 1)

#Annotations
#convert x-axis into 0-1 to make text placement easier
trans = transforms.blended_transform_factory(ax_main.transAxes, ax_main.transData)

ax_main.text(
    x = 0.01,
    y = df['goal'].iloc[0] + 0.0075 * df['goal'].iloc[0],
    s = 'Goal',
    color = '#14532d',
    fontsize = 12,
    ha = 'left',
    va = 'bottom',
    transform = trans
)

#Main figure labels
ax_main.set(
    xlabel = "",
    ylabel = "Environmental Indicator (count)"
)
#format x-axis date
ax_main.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%b-%y'))

#set y-axis limit to zero
ax_main.set_ylim(bottom = 0)

ax_main.legend(
    loc='lower left',
    bbox_to_anchor = (0,0.975),
    ncol=2,
    frameon=False
)

#------------------------------------------
#Inset Figure
#-----------------------------------------
ax_inset = ax_main.inset_axes([0.65, 0.055, 0.3, 0.35])
ax_inset.set_facecolor('white') #ensures white background so vertical line in main figure falls behind

#current progress to goal
ax_inset.bar(
    x = 0,
    height = progress_pct,
    color = '#6c2b81',
    width = 0.6,
    label = 'This Bay'
)

#current progress bar label
ax_inset.text(
    x = 0,
    y = progress_pct,
    s = f'{progress_pct:,.0f}%',
    ha = 'center',
    va = 'bottom',
    fontsize = 9,
    fontweight = 'bold',
    color = 'black'
)

#vertical divider separating the report location from the comparison bays
ax_inset.axvline(x = 0.5, color = '#dddddd', linewidth = 1, zorder = 1)

#comparison bays
bay_positions = range(1, len(df_compare) +1)  #automatically updates if data added in future
ax_inset.bar(
    x = bay_positions,
    height = df_compare['progress'],
    color = '#A0ABC2',
    width = 0.6,
    label = 'Comparison Bays'
)

#comparison bay labels
for x, height in zip(bay_positions, df_compare['progress']):
    ax_inset.text(
        x = x,
        y = height,
        s = f"{height:,.0f}%",
        ha = 'center',
        va = 'bottom',
        fontsize = 9,
        fontweight = 'bold',
        color = 'black'
    )

#x-axis report location first, then comparison bays
ax_inset.set_xlim(-0.6, len(df_compare) + 0.6)
ax_inset.set_xticks([0] + list(bay_positions))
ax_inset.set_xticklabels(['This Bay'] + df_compare['bay'].tolist(), fontsize = 8)

#set y axis limits to give padding for the bar labels
max_val = max(progress_pct, df_compare['progress'].max())
ax_inset.set_ylim(0, max_val * 1.15)
ax_inset.set_yticks([])

#set inset figure title
ax_inset.set_title("Progress to Goal\nBay Comparison", fontsize = 10)

plt.show()

```

```{python}
#| echo: false

summary_data = {
    "Metric": ["Most Recent Count", "Goal", "Progress Towards Goal"],
    "Value": [f"{metric_at_report_date:,.1f}", f"{goal:.0f}", f"{progress_pct:.0f}%"]
}
summary_df = pd.DataFrame(summary_data)

styled_table = (
    summary_df.style
    .hide(axis='index')
    .hide(axis='columns')
    .set_properties(**{
        'padding': '8px',
        'text-align': 'left',
        'font-family': 'Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif'
    })
    .set_table_styles([
        {'selector': 'table', 'props': [('border-collapse','collapse')]},
        {'selector': 'thead', 'props': [('background-color', '#f2f2f2')]}
    ])
)
display(HTML(styled_table.to_html()))
```
